reasoning: Differentiating V=(4/3)πr³ gives dV/dt=4πr² dr/dt. At r=3, dr/dt=−54π/(36π)=−1.5 cm/s, so the radius decreases at 1.5 cm/s. This matches the earlier answer, its Correct grade, and the worked solution.
